source.sourceReaderTitleSpanish: El reclamo del fin de semana
source.sourceLessonTitleEnglish: Insurance Adjuster After the Weekend Leak
source.sourceObjectiveEnglish: Tell an insurance adjuster what happened over the weekend and give clear quantities, times and locations.

rows.japanese: 月曜日の朝、保険の担当者が現場に来ました。
rows.english: On Monday morning, an insurance representative came to the site.

rows.japanese: 職長は、週末に見つかった水漏れについて説明しました。
rows.english: The foreman described the leak found over the weekend.

rows.japanese: 警備員の報告書には、発見した時刻が記録されています。
rows.english: The security guard’s report records the time of discovery.

rows.japanese: 二人は、報告書と現場の写真を見比べました。
rows.english: They compared the report with photographs of the site.

rows.japanese: 職長は、石膏ボードとタイルの箱があった場所を示しました。
rows.english: The foreman showed where the drywall and boxes of tile had been.

rows.japanese: 担当者は、確認できた数量を尋ねました。
rows.english: The representative asked for the quantities that had been confirmed.

rows.japanese: 職長は、確認済みの数字と未確認の数字を分けて伝えました。
rows.english: The foreman distinguished confirmed figures from those still unverified.

rows.japanese: 最後に、追加で必要な記録を一緒にリストにしました。
rows.english: Finally, they made a list of additional records needed.

openDomainReview.question: Preserve Monday 8:00 at La Fogata, adjuster Silvia Navarro, foreman Roberto Díaz, the company's policy number, Saturday coupling failure above the kitchen door, Sunday guard discovery and 6:10 shutoff, 6:15 call, guard report and 7:30 photos. A qualified Japanese/insurance reviewer must settle adjuster, claim, policy and incident-report terms without implying a claim decision.

Preserve the stated 600 square feet, power shutoff report, two industrial vacuums before 10:00 Sunday, 24 drywall sheets, nine tile boxes and three still-wet wall bottoms. Attribute actions and measurements to Roberto; a qualified construction/moisture reviewer must settle drywall, tile, standing-water and moisture-meter senses and source units. This is incident narration, not an independent electrical or water-removal procedure.

Preserve Roberto's report of two dehumidifiers and his stated mold-prevention purpose, his invoice question, and Silvia's request for invoices today plus photos and report added to the claim. A qualified Japanese/moisture/insurance reviewer must choose exact dehumidifier, mold and invoice language without presenting the character's prevention claim as verified outcome.

rows.sourceSpanish: El lunes a las 8:00, la ajustadora Silvia Navarro llegó a la remodelación del restaurante La Fogata para revisar un reclamo por daños de agua.
rows.sourceEnglish: On Monday at 8:00, the adjuster Silvia Navarro arrived at the La Fogata restaurant remodel to review a water damage claim.

rows.sourceSpanish: Roberto Díaz, el encargado de la obra, le dio el número de póliza de la constructora.
rows.sourceEnglish: Roberto Díaz, the site foreman, gave her the construction company's policy number.

rows.sourceSpanish: Silvia: ¿Cuándo encontraron el agua, quién la cerró y cuánto material se dañó?
rows.sourceEnglish: Silvia: When did you find the water, who shut it off and how much material was damaged?
rows.speaker: Silvia

rows.sourceSpanish: Roberto: El sábado se rompió un cople de la línea temporal.
rows.sourceEnglish: Roberto: On Saturday a coupling on the temporary line broke.
rows.speaker: Roberto
rows.conditionalJapanesePhrase: 土曜日に、仮設の給水管の継手が破損しました。

rows.sourceSpanish: Roberto: El cople estaba en la línea de agua temporal, arriba de la puerta de la cocina.
rows.sourceEnglish: Roberto: The coupling was on the temporary water line, above the kitchen door.
rows.speaker: Roberto

rows.sourceSpanish: Roberto: El domingo temprano el guardia de seguridad vio el agua durante su ronda.
rows.sourceEnglish: Roberto: Early on Sunday the security guard saw the water during his rounds.
rows.speaker: Roberto

rows.sourceSpanish: Roberto: El guardia cerró la llave el domingo a las 6:10.
rows.sourceEnglish: Roberto: The guard shut the valve on Sunday at 6:10.
rows.speaker: Roberto
rows.conditionalJapanesePhrase: 日曜日の6時10分に、警備員が止水弁を閉めました。

rows.sourceSpanish: Roberto: Usó la llave de paso de la entrada de atrás y me llamó a las 6:15.
rows.sourceEnglish: Roberto: He used the shutoff valve at the back entrance and called me at 6:15.
rows.speaker: Roberto

rows.sourceSpanish: Roberto: Aquí tiene el reporte del guardia con las horas exactas.
rows.sourceEnglish: Roberto: Here is the guard's report with the exact times.
rows.speaker: Roberto
rows.conditionalJapanesePhrase: こちらが、正確な時刻を記載した警備員の報告書です。

rows.sourceSpanish: Roberto: Yo llegué a las 7:30 y tomé fotos de todo.
rows.sourceEnglish: Roberto: I arrived at 7:30 and took photos of everything.
rows.speaker: Roberto
rows.conditionalJapanesePhrase: 7時30分に到着し、すべてを写真に撮りました。

rows.sourceSpanish: Roberto: El área afectada fue la cocina y el comedor, unos 600 pies cuadrados en total.
rows.sourceEnglish: Roberto: The affected area was the kitchen and the dining room, about 600 square feet in total.
rows.speaker: Roberto

rows.sourceSpanish: Roberto: Primero cortamos la electricidad del área y después sacamos el agua estancada con 2 aspiradoras industriales antes de las 10:00 del domingo.
rows.sourceEnglish: Roberto: First we cut the power to the area, and then we removed the standing water with 2 industrial vacuums before 10:00 on Sunday.
rows.speaker: Roberto

rows.sourceSpanish: Roberto: Se dañaron 24 hojas de tablaroca en la cocina y el comedor.
rows.sourceEnglish: Roberto: 24 sheets of drywall were damaged in the kitchen and dining room.
rows.speaker: Roberto
rows.conditionalJapanesePhrase: キッチンとダイニングの石膏ボード24枚が損傷しました。

rows.sourceSpanish: Roberto: También se mojaron 9 cajas de loseta que estaban en el piso.
rows.sourceEnglish: Roberto: 9 boxes of tile that were on the floor also got wet.
rows.speaker: Roberto
rows.conditionalJapanesePhrase: 床に置いてあったタイル9箱も濡れました。

rows.sourceSpanish: Roberto: Hoy a las 7:00 medimos 3 paredes con el medidor de humedad, y las 3 todavía estaban mojadas por abajo.
rows.sourceEnglish: Roberto: Today at 7:00 we measured 3 walls with the moisture meter, and all 3 were still wet at the bottom.
rows.speaker: Roberto

rows.sourceSpanish: Roberto: Pusimos 2 deshumidificadores para que no salga moho.
rows.sourceEnglish: Roberto: We set up 2 dehumidifiers so mold doesn't grow.
rows.speaker: Roberto
rows.conditionalJapanesePhrase: カビが生えないように、除湿機を2台設置しました。

rows.sourceSpanish: Roberto: ¿Quiere que le mande las facturas del material dañado?
rows.sourceEnglish: Roberto: Do you want me to send you the invoices for the damaged material?
rows.speaker: Roberto
rows.conditionalJapanesePhrase: 損傷した材料の購入時の請求書をお送りしましょうか。

rows.sourceSpanish: Silvia: Sí, mándemelas hoy y yo agrego las fotos y el reporte al reclamo.
rows.sourceEnglish: Silvia: Yes, send them to me today and I will add the photos and the report to the claim.
rows.speaker: Silvia
